en: Black-and-white aerial photograph of a mountainous lake area with scattered cabins, dirt roads, forested hills and open meadows. At the lower edge is a lake shore with small buildings along the water, and further up are a few larger hotel‑like buildings. Printed caption text at the bottom right reads the number of the photo, the place name, and the photographer/company credit.
